title: P8: executor image polish from approving security review T-0184 (venv protection, gh pin and gitconfig mount, frozen uv)
spec:
Bring-up notes from the approving security review of C-O5 (Dockerfile, docker-compose.executor.yml, docs/executor-host.md, .orchestrator/protected-paths.txt).
1. .orchestrator/protected-paths.txt gains the container path of the orchestrator .venv (executed code) so guardrails.sh blocks writes to it inside the container.
2. Dockerfile: gh is installed at a pinned version with a checksum or apt pin, and the build asserts `gh --version` prints that version (like the codex asset check).
3. docker-compose.executor.yml: mount a read-only gitconfig for the orch user (the file gh auth setup-git writes) and document in docs/executor-host.md the human step that produces it.
4. Entrypoint and the installer module run uv with --frozen (uv sync --frozen / uv run --frozen) against the root-owned project dir; document why.
Tests: new tests/test_image.py with grep-based assertions on the four files (no docker build in the gate).
acceptance: docs/executor-host.md has a numbered human step for producing the gitconfig

result.summary:
## Summary

Implemented the four bring-up hardening items from the C-O5 security review, all in scope.

**Files changed:**
- `.orchestrator/protected-paths.txt` — added `/opt/orchestrator/.venv` (executed code) so guardrails.sh blocks writes to it in-container.
- `Dockerfile` — replaced the floating `cli.github.com` apt repo install of `gh` with a checksummed download of the pinned release tarball (`GH_VERSION=2.101.0`, real sha256 checksums fetched from the release's own `gh_2.101.0_checksums.txt`), with a build-time `gh --version | grep -qF "gh version ${GH_VERSION}"` assertion mirroring the codex asset check; added `--frozen` to the entrypoint's `uv run` (the build-time `uv sync` already had it) with a comment on why (root-owned project dir, fail fast on lock mismatch).
- `docker-compose.executor.yml` — added a read-only `${ORCH_CREDS}/gitconfig:/home/orch/.gitconfig:ro` mount, with a comment explaining why it's read-only.
- `docs/executor-host.md` — inserted a new numbered step ("8. Generate the git credential helper config") documenting the one-off `docker run` bootstrap that produces the host gitconfig file via `gh auth setup-git` before the read-only mount takes over; renumbered the following steps (9. Bring it up, 10. Smoke test).
- `tests/test_image.py` (new) — grep-based tests: `test_protected_paths_cover_venv`, `test_dockerfile_pins_gh_and_asserts_version`, `test_compose_mounts_gitconfig_readonly`, `test_uv_runs_frozen`, plus `test_executor_host_has_numbered_gitconfig_step`.

**Test output:** full suite (283 tests, including the 5 new ones) passes; `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exits 0 with no failures.

Committed as `a99ce71` on `task/T-0209`.
